correctness.rationale: The continuous extremizer is certified by rewriting it with \(T_n\) as the gap between \(T_n\) and its tangent at \(C=\cos(\pi/(2n))\). Monotonicity of \(\sin(nt)/\sin t\) gives strict convexity on the terminal Chebyshev arc, while the explicit tangent bound handles the complementary interval, so the only zeros are the two contact points \(\pi\pm\pi/(2n)\). Their reduced turn fractions have denominator \(4n\), hence a grid contains a contact iff \(4n\mid m\). At a contact, evaluation gives the sharp upper bound; without contacts, finite strict positivity permits an explicit positive coefficient bump. Independent dense/finite checks over \(3\le n<25\) and \(3\le m<120\) reproduced contacts and strict margins.
risks: The theorem classifies equality versus strict gain but deliberately leaves the off-resonance value, including aliasing/infinite cases, unclassified.
